div.p: From the first enquiry to the vehicle's next booking. One customer, one reservation, one rental — carried through every step.
Use Continue to advance and Save & Exit to resume later. Each step keeps its records linked, so nothing is entered twice.

page.name: guide_start

div.p: Register customers, prepare bookings, issue agreements, complete inspections and record handovers and returns.
Approve destination rates and price overrides, manage agreement templates and renew expired signing links.
Review and confirm invoices, record payments and deposits, settle charges, refund deposits and close rentals.
Prepare vehicles, manage compliance and repairs, complete cleaning and release vehicles for hire.

page.p: Car Rental Admin combines the rental roles; an administrator configures company settings. Buttons and menus follow these permissions — if a button is missing, ask your administrator to check your rental role.

Customers holds identity and licence details (Odoo Contacts). Bookings runs the guided journey and holds reservations and rentals. Rental Agreements holds templates and signed agreements. Fleet holds vehicles, inspections, damage and maintenance. Payments holds invoices, receipts, deposits and refunds. Configuration holds categories, destinations, pricing rules and settings.
page.h2: What counts as a completed cycle?

ul.li: The rental is Returned and both inspections are complete.
The hire invoice and any final settlement invoice are confirmed, posted and settled, or an outstanding balance is being followed up.
The deposit has been refunded or applied to approved charges; the amount held is zero.
Damage and repairs are resolved, cleaning is done and the vehicle is released.

page.p: Returned describes the physical return. The accountant uses Close Rental to record financial completion. Cleaning and release are separate fleet tasks.

page.name: guide_setup

ol.li: In Configuration → Vehicle Categories and Destinations, create the categories and destinations you serve.
In Configuration → Pricing Rules, enter daily rates, duration bands, validity dates and the deposit ratio. A manager must click Approve Rate; draft rates cannot confirm a booking.

In Fleet → Vehicles, add the registration, category, photo, odometer and compliance documents with expiry dates. Use the number plate as Fleet ID and activate the completed vehicle. Only real registered vehicles appear in dashboard totals.

Accounting is set up for you: the rental income, damage, deposit liability, clearing and expense accounts plus the bank and sales journals are created automatically and linked in Configuration → Settings. Review them and the charge products and sales taxes for your business. If a field is cleared, it is repaired automatically the next time you invoice.

Confirm the agreement template is active in Rental Agreements → Templates. Decide whether full payment, valid compliance documents and a tracker are required at pickup, and set the late-return grace period.
Assign users the appropriate rental roles.

page.div: Deposit calculation: agreed daily rate × deposit ratio, separate from the rental total. The screen shows the Pula amount with a 50% minimum. For example, a daily rate of 500 with a ratio of 1 requires a 500 deposit even on a three-day rental. These numbers are illustrative.
page.p: Signing links need a public URL. Set web.base.url to your publicly reachable HTTPS address before sending a signing link. Localhost, private addresses and HTTP links are blocked.

page.name: guide_agreements
page.p: Agreements behave like Odoo quotation templates. A template holds the approved contract wording and its field mapping; each agreement is a dated snapshot of that template plus the customer, vehicle and booking values. Changing a template never changes an agreement already issued.

ul.li: City Delights Standard Rental Agreement is installed with the original 10-page contract, three schedules and bank details.
A manager can activate, archive, create a new version or load the City Delights contract from Rental Agreements → Templates.
Customer, vehicle, rental, company, representative and witness values are pulled from Odoo records once and filled consistently throughout the document.

ol.li: Choose the template, customer and vehicle, then confirm the rental dates, delivery place and any representative or witness names.
Click Create Agreement, then Generate Agreement. Use Preview Agreement to check it before sending.
Download the 10-page PDF with Download PDF, or send the signing link from the booking's Agreement step.

page.p: Statuses move through Draft → Generated → Sent → Signing → Signed, or Cancelled. The renter confirms the details and enters only the place of signing; prices and the deposit are read-only. Additional named signers each get their own private link. Links expire after 30 days and a manager can renew an unsigned one without losing existing signatures. The signed PDF and the full audit trail are retained. Where Odoo Sign is available, a manager can send the agreement through it; otherwise the built-in private signing flow is used.
page.div: Signing links are private bearer links: anyone holding one can open that person's signing page. Send them only to the intended signer.

page.name: guide_booking
page.p: Open Customers and search before creating a duplicate. Enter the identity document, date of birth, addresses, licence details and next of kin, then upload the document and licence. Omang numbers must be exactly 9 digits; passport and licence numbers accept 6 to 20 letters or digits. A renter must be at least 21 with a licence valid through the whole hire.

In Bookings → New, select the customer, destination and category, then the pickup time and number of 24-hour days. The expected return is calculated automatically. Use Choose Vehicle & Preview to list available cars, preview one and apply it. Allocation checks overlapping bookings and vehicle readiness.
For a special rate, request a Price Override and have a manager approve it before confirmation. Do not edit the sales quotation to bypass the agreed price.

Continue creates a native Odoo Sales quotation with hire, refundable deposit and any delivery charge. Send it with Odoo's quotation email and confirm it from the booking or Sales — confirming advances the journey automatically. If delivery was requested, the popup captures its address and charge.

page.name: guide_pickup
page.p: Signing prepares a draft invoice covering the hire and refundable deposit — nothing is posted automatically. In the Payment step the accountant clicks Create Invoice if needed, then Review Invoice to check it and click Confirm in Odoo. Open Invoice is available once posted, and Record Payment only becomes available after that. A draft receipt does not count as money received.
Prior deposit credit from the customer's returned rentals is shown and applied by default. The accountant can adjust it; the remaining balance is paid normally.

The deposit is a refundable liability on the same invoice, held separately from rental income. It is satisfied when the invoice is settled or by an eligible prior-deposit credit — a rental receipt alone does not satisfy it.
page.h2: 6. Sign and inspect before handing over the keys
page.p: At Agreement, review the customer contact and delivery place, then send the signing link by email, WhatsApp or Telegram (or copy it). WhatsApp and Telegram prepare a message for staff to send. Once signed, the journey continues to Payment.
Complete the Pickup Inspection with the actual time, inspector, odometer, fuel, accessories, existing damage, photos and the customer's signature. Confirm the checklist and complete the inspection.

Hand Over Vehicle requires a confirmed reservation, completed inspection, signed agreement, required deposit, a ready vehicle and any enabled compliance checks. If full payment is required, posted receipts must cover the hire. The rental becomes Ongoing and the car Rented. Save & Exit while the customer has the car; reopen and click Begin Return Process when it comes back.

page.name: guide_return
page.p: Record the return odometer (pre-filled from Fleet), actual time and fuel. Compare the accessory checklist with pickup — missing items become a damage assessment. Add new damage, attach photos and obtain the customer's acknowledgement. Distance travelled is calculated from the two odometer readings. Late charges use the actual return time and the configured grace period.
Off-site collection can be selected at Return with an address and editable charge. If the car was clean at pickup and is returned dirty, or is late, confirm or edit those charges in the same popup.

A manager approves damage assessments under Fleet → Damage Assessments. Finance reviews the new charges and posts one final settlement invoice. Legacy rentals keep their separate cleaning, late and damage invoices and deposit application actions.

Apply the deposit to approved charges, pay any shortfall against the settlement invoice and refund the remaining balance. Check Payments → Outstanding Invoices before closing. Posting a receipt or refund records the accounting entry; staff still collect or return the physical money through the cash, bank or card process.
Close Rental validates that no charges, payments or deposits remain. Closing the customer cycle does not release the car.
Complete repairs in Maintenance, resolve the damage case, send the car to cleaning and then release it for the next hire. Use Vehicle / Fleet Follow-up from the booking.

page.name: guide_help

ul.li: Rental amount: the agreed hire charge including tax.
Paid total / rental balance: posted base receipts and the remaining base charge.
Total Customer Balance: outstanding posted invoices, including damage, late and cleaning charges. Check draft invoices separately before closing.
Deposit held: collections less refunds and damage applications. It is customer money held as a liability, not income.

page.p: Example: three days at 500, no tax, ratio 1 means a 1,500 hire invoice plus a separately held 500 deposit. With no damage, refund 500. With 200 approved damage, apply 200 of the deposit and refund 300. Settle any late invoice separately.

ul.li: No approved rate: ask a manager to approve a rule matching destination, category, duration and date, then recalculate.
No vehicle available: check category, dates, overlapping bookings and vehicle readiness.
Pickup blocked: check the agreement, signed inspection, posted deposit, posted receipts and vehicle compliance.
Record Payment missing: confirm and post the draft invoice first.
Refund blocked: complete the return inspection and settle assessed charges before refunding the remainder.
Vehicle cannot be released: resolve damage and send the car to cleaning first.
Signing link will not open: check that web.base.url is a public HTTPS address.
Historical receipts: have finance reconcile opening balances before new invoices; do not charge twice.

page.p: Completed inspections, signed agreements and posted transactions are protected history. Finance uses accounting reversals for corrections.
